What happens to my Facebook when I die?

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026

Short answer: Facebook either memorialises your profile, adding 'Remembering' next to your name, or permanently deletes it, depending on what you chose in advance. A legacy contact you name can manage parts of a memorialised profile, such as a pinned tribute post, but can't log in or read your messages. Family can request memorialisation with proof of death.

Key facts

  • Options: memorialise or delete
  • Legacy contact: can't log in or read messages
  • You must be 18+ to choose a legacy contact
  • Set in Accounts Centre → Memorialisation

How do I prepare my Facebook account?

  1. Go to Menu → Settings & privacy → Settings → Accounts Centre → Personal details → Account ownership and control → Memorialisation.
  2. Pick a legacy contact, or choose to have the account deleted after death.
  3. Family can request memorialisation through Facebook's memorialisation request form, with proof of death.

Read the official policy ↗

What documents do heirs need?

  • Memorialisation: proof of death such as an obituary
  • Removal: proof you're immediate family or the executor, such as a death certificate

How long does it take?

Requests are reviewed by Facebook; no fixed timeframe is published.

What can't be recovered?

  • Private messages
  • Login access for anyone, including the legacy contact

Frequently asked questions

What happens to my Facebook when I die?

Facebook either memorialises your profile, adding 'Remembering' next to your name, or permanently deletes it, depending on what you chose in advance. A legacy contact you name can manage parts of a memorialised profile, such as a pinned tribute post, but can't log in or read your messages. Family can request memorialisation with proof of death.

Can a legacy contact read my messages?

No. They can manage a pinned tribute post, profile photo and friend requests, but not messages. You can optionally let them download a copy of what you shared.

Can family delete a Facebook account?

Verified immediate family or an executor can request removal.

Can I choose deletion instead?

Yes. In the Memorialisation settings you can choose to have your account permanently deleted after your death.

Is Instagram the same?

No. Instagram offers memorialisation and removal requests but works differently. See our Instagram page.
